content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** T4C is a **deviation** (walk-away territory). The Agreement runs three years (§ 8.1) with no Customer convenience right anywhere — Section 9 covers only material breach, insolvency and security/SLA/law-violation termination, and § 2.1 affirmatively locks Customer into a take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights." Section 8.2 non-renewal is a natural-term mechanic (RENEWAL, not T4C) and § 27.3 is a force-majeure exit, so neither substitutes.

**Redline (preferred level, two surgical ops):**
1. New § 9.4 after § 9.3: Customer convenience termination on thirty days' written notice, plus an express bar on Vendor convenience termination during a committed term.
2. § 2.1 conformed to "without reduction rights but subject to Customer's termination rights" — removing the contradiction while keeping the no-reduction restriction intact.

Prepaid-fee refund was not re-drafted: § 10.2 already requires Vendor to "refund prepaid recurring Fees covering the period after termination," which reaches convenience termination.
